title: Ship the integrated single-path SDK and Gallery
requires: Any development host; access to current API, schedule and qualification records
scope: Package, deploy and document the integrated single-path SDK and Gallery candidate after the required F8 correctness/device rows complete. Apply the 2026-11-03 timing deferral in docs/roadmap/PHYSICS-QUALITY-DEVELOPMENT.md. Publish the delivery as an F8 integration release with explicit scene-quality and performance limitations. Normal simulation creation uses the fixed-tick architecture. Verify installed revision/backend/artifact identities for desktop launchers, Android and iPad. Follow docs/roadmap/F8-SINGLE-EXECUTION-PATH.md and docs/roadmap/F8-DISPATCH-REDUCTION.md. Scene improvements and final timing qualification continue in F9.
acceptance: Installed public C/C++ SDK and Gallery tests use normal creation and stepping with no execution-profile request. Every supported domain/interaction uses the same schedule; incompatible API/ABI requests fail clearly.

Publish exact device/workload quality and performance limits and migration instructions for the single architecture; historical evidence is not relabeled and missing integration cannot be hidden as unsupported hardware.

Relocatable packages and installed desktop/mobile applications match the frozen candidate's artifact/revision/backend identities, including the macOS Dock launcher. Material runtime/kernel/API/app changes require candidate refresh and affected requalification.
Show 30/60/high-refresh presentation, bounded long-running memory ownership, lifecycle recovery and ordinary Gallery startup with no user-facing F8 toggle.

Publish the final candidate's F8-54--56 actual native dispatch/work reductions and independent ceilings alongside its quality and frame timings. Installed Mac/iPad identities match the measured candidate; preserve comparable workload counts and disclose remaining limits.

Release notes distinguish passing integration/correctness/work-budget evidence from outstanding scene quality and measured timing targets. Report timing-only misses under F9-07/F9-08. A broad 60 Hz performance qualification claim requires later passing evidence.

history.reason: Shipped the candidate-v10 single-path SDK and Gallery development integration with verified Apple installs, relocatable package evidence, dispatch reductions, migration guidance, and explicit Android, D3D12, Linux-reference, scene-quality, and timing limitations
